Name: Additional Pastoral Redrawn Compatibility
Author: RedxMoonxRose
Description:
[size=5]Information:[/size]

[size=3]This mod is a collection of edits that I made for other mods that add their own additions to the world and/or map so that they match the theme of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Redrawn[/url]﻿. It is somewhat jarring to be suddenly hit with bright orange after all! [/size]

Mods:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9600]Visit Mount Vapius[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11111]Sunberry [/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29049]ReMapping - Minimap Project[/url]﻿ (Spring Done)
[/list]
[size=5]Installation: [/size]
[size=3]1. Install the latest version of the required mod (listed in the Requirement tab or as the name for the separated files) 
3. Install the mod
4. Unzip the file, place the folder in your Mods folder, and overwrite the original mod's assets 
5. Launch your game and enjoy! [/size]
